review.body: { if let Some (primary) = self . first_refusal { Err (self . transaction . refuse (primary) . await) } else { self . transaction . commit () . await . map_err (Into :: into) } }
review.item_premise: The consuming reader ends its borrowed snapshot with a wrapped COMMIT or a cleanup rollback retaining the first local refusal. It returns only a closed error and carries no diagnostic payload. Dropping it unended retires the shared session.
